evidence: Recently amorphous MoS 2 thin film has attracted great attention as an emerging material for electrochemical hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) catalyst. Here we prepare the amorphous MoS 2 catalyst on Au by atomic layer deposition (ALD) using molybdenum hexacarbonyl (Mo(CO) 6 ) and dimethyldisulfide (CH 3S2CH 3) as Mo and S precursors, respectively.
